pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with smooth-curved to slightly angular edge gradients. Dark brown contiguous patches exhibit varying spatial areas, with larger, more elongated shapes on the upper neck transitioning to smaller, more fragmented sub-hexagonal geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of high-contrast light pelage forming a lattice. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections. Corridor thickness remains relatively uniform across the central flank with narrowing pathways observed near the ventral transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background. The mane presents as a continuous fuzzy boundary with high-frequency pixel-level variations in height along the cervical-dorsal transition.
